content.title: Tigres UANL
content.text: Tigres UANL Tigres UANL Profile Roster Fixtures Profile Profile Roster Fixtures Tigres UANL qualified for the 2026 Concacaf Champions Cup as the next best club in the 2024–25 Liga MX overall standings. In its most recent Champions Cup appearance, it reached the Semifinals. Champions Cup Appearances: 13 (1979, 1981, 1983, 2013, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) Record: GP-74 W-36 D-23 L-15 GF-123 GA-66 Titles: 1 (2020) Top scorers: André-Pierre Gignac (20), Enner Valencia (10), Eduardo Vargas (7), Luis Quiñones (6). Most saves (since 2008/09): Nahuel Guzmán (127), Enrique Palos (15), Felipe Rodríguez (6). Most Assists (since 2008/09): Luis Quiñones (10), Jürgen Damm Rascón (5), Diego Lainez (4), Luis Alfonso Rodríguez (4), Rafael de Souza (4), Jesús Dueñas (4), Javier Aquino (4).
